res://art/audio/voices/ch1/ch1_side_cara.speaker: 范掌柜
res://art/audio/voices/ch1/ch1_side_cara.text: 这趟货能平安过去，村里的伤药就不会断。我会把酬钱和货样交给村里的镖局枪手。回竹尾村后找他就能领到。

res://art/audio/voices/ch8/ch8_false_ord.speaker: 烈云护使
res://art/audio/voices/ch8/ch8_false_ord.text: 证人已经到位。守住退路，谁来也得先对印。

res://art/audio/voices/ch8/ch8_false_ord.speaker: 茗雾假令传使
res://art/audio/voices/ch8/ch8_false_ord.text: 奉会盟手令，拿下两名证人！五派若再袒护，一并按通敌论处！

res://art/audio/voices/ch8/ch8_false_ord.speaker: 五派代表
res://art/audio/voices/ch8/ch8_false_ord.text: 且慢！副卷上只有半枚朱印，谁准你在祭台拿人？

res://art/audio/voices/ch8/ch8_false_ord.speaker: 茗雾护令客
res://art/audio/voices/ch8/ch8_false_ord.text: 令在这里，刀也在这里。让开！

res://art/audio/voices/ch8/ch8_false_ord.speaker: 冷孤云
res://art/audio/voices/ch8/ch8_false_ord.text: 证人在我身后。要动他们，先把你手里那半枚印交出来。
